meta.name: firebase-security-rules-auditor
meta.description: A skill to evaluate how secure Firestore security rules are. Use this when Firestore security rules are updated to ensure that the generated rules are extremely secure and robust.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计 Firestore 安全规则,确保数据访问安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理 Firestore 数据库并需要确保规则安全
copy.tagline_en: Audit Firestore security rules to ensure data access safety
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Firestore and need to ensure rule security

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像安全审计员一样检查你的 Firestore 安全规则，找出漏洞并给出 1-5 分的评分和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你更新 Firestore 安全规则，或要求 Claude 审计现有规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下这段 Firestore 安全规则。
say.note: Claude 会分析规则并返回评分和问题列表。

say.text: 检查我的 Firestore 规则有没有权限提升漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会重点检查角色和权限相关风险。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a security auditor for Firestore security rules, evaluating them against a checklist and scoring 1-5, then providing findings and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you update Firestore security rules or ask Claude to audit existing rules.

say_en.text: Audit this Firestore security rule for me.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and return a score and issues.

say_en.text: Check my Firestore rules for privilege escalation vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on role and permission risks.
